create.name: Sadhvi Bhagawati Saraswati
create.bio:
Sadhvi Bhagawati Saraswati, widely known as Sadhviji, is an American-born Hindu renunciate who has lived at Parmarth Niketan ashram in Rishikesh, on the Ganges, for close to thirty years. She grew up in Los Angeles, studied at Stanford and holds a doctorate in psychology; a visit to India in the 1990s changed the direction of her life, and she later took monastic vows under Pujya Swami Chidanand Saraswati, the ashram's spiritual head. Her teaching draws on Vedanta and the yoga tradition and is known for plain, practical answers to everyday questions about the mind, relationships, forgiveness and purpose.

She holds regular satsang at the ashram, streamed online, where she answers questions sent in from around the world, and she directs the International Yoga Festival held there each year. Her books include Come Home to Yourself, a collection of questions and answers, and the memoir Hollywood to the Himalayas, and she has recorded self-paced courses for several online platforms. Alongside teaching she leads interfaith water and sanitation work through the Global Interfaith WASH Alliance and education projects through the Divine Shakti Foundation, and she travels each year to speak and lead retreats in the United States and elsewhere.

books.title: Hollywood to the Himalayas: A Journey of Healing and Transformation
books.author: Sadhvi Bhagawati Saraswati
books.description: Her memoir of growing up in Los Angeles, travelling to India as a young woman and choosing life at a Himalayan ashram. It follows how the teachings she met there reshaped her sense of who she is.

books.title: Come Home to Yourself: Simple Answers to Life's Essential Questions
books.author: Sadhvi Bhagawati Saraswati
books.description: A book of questions put to her at satsang and her answers, grouped by theme: peace of mind, emotions, relationships, purpose and the Divine. Each answer is short and meant to be put into practice.

books.title: By God's Grace: The Life and Teachings of Pujya Swami Chidanand Saraswati
books.author: Sadhvi Bhagawati Saraswati
books.description: A large illustrated book on the life and work of her teacher, the head of Parmarth Niketan, from his early years of practice to his teaching and service projects.

courses.title: Yoga and the Path of Discovery
courses.description: A long weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, co-taught with yoga teacher Tommy Rosen. Days combine asana, pranayama, meditation and satsang, framed around the Eight Limbs of Yoga, with question-and-answer time at the end of each session. Open to all levels.

courses.title: Freedom from the Mind: The Ancient Yogic Path to Stillness, Clarity, and Inner Peace
courses.description: A three-day programme at the Sivananda Ashram Yoga Retreat on Paradise Island, Bahamas, with two satsangs and three workshops. It brings together Advaita Vedanta, meditation and some findings from neuroscience on stepping back from thought and resting in awareness.

courses.title: Divine Flow
courses.description: A self-paced Shift Network course of seven pre-recorded 90-minute modules on surrender as a spiritual practice. It covers loosening the need for control, setting down old stories and trusting a larger intelligence at work in daily life.

courses.title: Hollywood to the Himalayas: The Experience
courses.description: A video course of 21 lessons, about four and a half hours in total, built on her memoir. Through talks, meditations and reflection it contrasts a mindset built on achievement and image with a view of the self as consciousness.
courses.price: Pay what you wish: $1 to $101 USD

courses.title: Ego Death: Restore Your True Self-Identity
courses.description: An eight-lesson DailyOM course on noticing the ego's habits and letting them loosen. It joins yogic teaching on the self with ideas from modern psychology, aiming at steadier relationships and a clearer sense of identity.
courses.price: Pay what you can: $22, $33 or $44 USD

courses.title: Pathway to Freedom: Letting Go and Living in the River of Love
courses.description: A digital programme from Learning Strategies in eight written lessons on letting go of fear, resentment and limiting beliefs. It presents happiness as a natural state uncovered rather than something to chase.

free_resources.title: Ask Sadhviji (podcast)
free_resources.description: Her podcast drawn from satsang at Parmarth Niketan, in which she answers listeners' questions on spiritual life, family, work and practice. Free on Apple Podcasts and other apps.

free_resources.title: Drops of Nectar for Joyful Living (podcast)
free_resources.description: An earlier podcast series of short talks on bringing yogic and Vedantic teaching into everyday life. Free to listen.

free_resources.title: Come Home to Yourself: A 30-Day Guide to Remembering Who You Are
free_resources.description: A free downloadable guide with a reflection, practice or exercise for each day of a month, based on her book. It is sent by email after signing up.

flags: Also on The Shift Network: Divine Flow is a current on-demand course there (and she is in the-shift-network-faculty.json), so the-shift-network is added to teaches_at.
No email published on sadhviji.org; the contact form is the 'Contact' pop-up on the Press and Media page (name, email, organisation, subject, message).
Editorial stature is high (International Director of Parmarth Niketan, UN and interfaith work, two Sounds True books); tier left at luminary by count, owner may want to consider superhero.
Kripalu programme is co-taught with Tommy Rosen, who may be a separate listing in this sprint.

Book title 'Hollywood to the Himalayas: A Journey of Healing and Transformation' uses 'healing' in a general sense and the publisher blurb mentions trauma and anxiety; kept with a neutral description. Borderline.
Offerings sit on several third-party platforms (Shift Network, Thinkific, DailyOM, Learning Strategies); the Learning Strategies URL is given without the affiliate parameter used on her site.
Kripalu's bio misspells her name ('Sadvi Bjagawati').
left_out: From Illness to Wellness: Health, Wholeness and Holiness (book): health framing, and not on Amazon (Haranand Books only).
Mother Ganga: The Holy River (book): Haranand Books only, no Amazon listing found.
Unshakeable and Returning to What Matters Most free guides: descriptions name grief, anxiety and healing emotional wounds.
Videos 'The Kind of Stillness That Makes You Immune to Anxiety', the David Perlmutter brain and memory-loss interview and 'Do You Really Need Meat for Protein?': condition-named or under-length/diet.
Horasis Global Summit (Nov 2026) and The Angkor Conference (Jan 2027): conferences where she speaks, not her own offerings.
Talks on other channels (Republic World interview, Synapse Conclave panel): own channel used first.
